stories.title: Saltney school closures: formal objection period opens until 1 December
stories.summary: People who want to object to plans to close Saltney Ferry and Saltney Wood Memorial primary schools have until 1 December to do so. Flintshire County Council published its statutory notice on the plans on 3 November, which opens a 28-day objection period. Comments made during the summer consultation will not be counted as objections,

stories.title: Planned power cut for properties around Oakenholt Lane near Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: Properties around Oakenholt Lane, near Connah’s Quay, are without power today while SP Energy Networks carries out planned work on the network. The company said the electricity was turned off so the network could be upgraded safely. It expects supplies to be back on by 4pm on Wednesday, 4 November. Postcodes CH6 5SU, CH6 5SX

stories.title: Labour backs Plaid budget four months after summer defeat
stories.summary: The Senedd has approved the Welsh Government’s revised spending plans for this year, nearly four months after the first version was voted down. MSs backed the £354 million second supplementary budget for 2026-27 by 54 votes to 39 on Tuesday night. There were no abstentions. The minority Plaid Cymru government got the votes it needed

stories.title: Remembrance Sunday road closures in Mold, Flint, Holywell, Buckley and Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: Roads will close in nine Flintshire towns and villages on Sunday 8 November as communities hold Remembrance Sunday services. The first closures start at 9am in Mold and in Hope and Caergwrle, and the last, in Flint, run until 4.30pm. Service details have been published for Mold, Flint, Hawarden and Buckley so far. Bagillt, 12pm

stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS raises cancer waits and cross-border treatment
stories.summary: A Fflint Wrecsam MS has asked the First Minister what arrangements are in place for north Wales cancer patients to be treated elsewhere in the UK when services in Wales cannot meet their needs. Nigel Williams MS (Reform UK, Fflint Wrecsam) raised it during First Minister’s Questions on Tuesday, 3 November, in exchanges on cooperation
